name: advio20
imu_ext_note: R_BC (9, row-major) + t (3): runs/stella_vio/imu/ext_advio20_stella_fit.txt, rotation fitted from a visual trajectory + gyro of the SAME sequence (stella_vio/tools/ext_fit.py); the dataset-calibration variant is ext_advio20_stella_cal.txt / ext_advio20.txt
imu_toff_note: camera->IMU clock offset [s] from the same fit (ext_fit.py)
imu_bg_note: gyro bias from the first <=60 s visual fit (runs/stella_vio/imu/gyro_pred.md); only used by gyro=1
fixes_note: phone GNSS fixes (ns, E, N, U, hErr1, hErr2, vErr)

gait.note: generic population constant 0.389 (another person/phone than Mobile-GVIO, no held-out calibration sequence of the same user)

imu_ext_cal_note: dataset-calibration extrinsic (runs/stella_vio/imu/ext_advio20.txt), no fit to the sequence; used by the sensitivity variant fullcal
